RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, November 11, 2010/Kartika 20, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Communications and
Information Technology; Culture; Earth Sciences; External
Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas
Indian Affairs; Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel,
Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning;
Science and Technology; Social Justice
and Empowerment; Space; Tourism;
Urban Development; Water
Resources; Y outh Affairs
and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
13
Steering group for economic
reforms
*41. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD SAHU:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up a steering group which would
monitor the implementation of economic
reforms proposed in the Plan document;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
its terms of reference;
(c) whether Government proposes to
implement some development schemes for
hundred most backward districts;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the strategy developed to supervise
the implementation of the scheme?
Panchayat Sanchar Sewa Yojana
*42. SHRI RAM KRIPAL Y ADAV:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether all villages in the country
have been covered under the Panchayat
Sanchar Sewa Yojana, specially in Bihar
State;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether any time-frame has been
fixed to achieve the target of this Scheme?

14
Strengthening of National
Commission for Scheduled Castes
*43. SHRIMA TI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by the Ministry for strengthening
the National Commission for Scheduled
Castes; and
(b) the reasons for not filling up the
post of Chairman of SC Commission in
spite of it remaining vacant for the last so
many months?
Metro rail in Jaipur
†*44. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the required criteria and
sufficient number of passengers have been
ensured before starting metro rail project
in Jaipur;
(b) whether it has been decided as to
who would meet the expenditure on this
project and the basis therefor;
(c) whether this project has been divided
into phases; and
(d) if so, by when it is likely to be
completed?
Extradition of Warren Anderson
*45. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL  AFFAIRS be pleased to refer
to answer to Starred Question 63 given in
the Rajya Sabha on 29th July, 2010 and
state:
(a) the action taken so far after 18-21
June, 2010 for extradition of Warren
Anderson; and
(b) whether this issue has been included
in the agenda of discussions between
President of USA and Government of
India?
Funds for construction of flats
*46. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds allocated to the
Ministry for construction of flats in CWG
Games Village;
(b) the details of funds utilized/spent,
project-wise;
(c) the details of the private builders/
construction companies which were
awarded tenders for construction of flats
in Games Village, project-wise;
(d) whether all construction companies
handed over the flats to DDA/the Ministry
in time; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor along with the action
taken against those companies for creating
a mess and tarnishing the reputation of the
country?
Shortage of water in cities
*47. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has made any
assessment of the actue shortage of water
in major metropolitan cities;
(b) if so, the steps to be taken in this
regard; and
(c) the action being taken in resolving
conflicts over inter-State rivers and their
contamination which are the major source
of water supply?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
India's rank in world hunger index
†*48. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India ranks
67th among the 85 nations of the world
particularly where hunger is in prevalence;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether Government has conducted
any survey at its own level to ascertain the
number of people in India who could not
afford two square meals a day; and
(d) if so, the estimated number of such
people?
Funds for JNNURM projects of
Maharashtra
*49. SHRI Y .P. TRIVEDI: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether 95 projects of Government
of Maharashtra including the underground
drainage scheme, are under active
consideration of the Ministry;
(b) whether non-release of sanctioned
funds for the scheme is coming in way of
non-implementation of the scheme;
(c) whether the required fund for the
scheme is likely to be released by
Government in phased manner or in
lumpsum; and
(d) the details thereof?
Allotment of land for public bodies
*50. SHRI RASHEED MASOOD: Will
the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of public bodies/public
utility services for which Government allots
land at concessional rates;
(b) the terms and conditions attached
with such allotments;
(c) whether it is a fact that land has
been allotted to Mother Dairy, hospitals,
schools, etc. in Delhi;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether they are scrupulously
observing the terms and conditions
attached with their allotments?
Mechanism for co-ordinating multiple
organizations during CWG
*51. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a mechanism was
constituted by Government at the apex
level, inter alia , for co-ordination with
multiple organizations involved in
implementation of projects related to the
XIX
th Commonwealth Games-2010 in
Delhi and monitoring progress thereof and
overall supervision etc.;
(b) if so, the details of the mechanism
so established indicating frequency of its
sittings since inception and issues
deliberated in respective sitting;
(c) whether Government was
confronted with advice/demands for
escalation of cost of projects and accorded
approval on each occasion; and
(d) if so, the details of determining the
rationale behind each such advice/demand
for escalations by the Cabinet?

16
Licence conditions of telecom
operators
*52. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
suggestions from the CAG to amend licence
conditions of telecom operators so as to
add a new clause requiring the CAG to audit
the accounts of private operators that
bagged 3-G spectrum;
(b) if so, the complete details in this
regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that according to
Article 149 of the Constitution of India,
CAG has no powers to challenge or amend
policy decisions of Government; and
(d) if so, the reasons that CAG has not
so far been apprised of their role, duties
and powers as laid down under Article 149
of the Constitution?
Metro trains in Delhi
*53. SHRIMATI T. RA TNA BAI: Will
the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether some Metro trains have
been commissioned in Delhi recently;
(b) if so, the complete details thereof,
route-wise; and
(c) the steps being taken to expand the
metro services to every nook and corner in
Delhi in future and the ongoing metro lines
and the funds allocated and spent for each
route and the targets fixed for completion
of project for each route?
Funds sanctioned for
JNNURM
*54. SHRI RANJITSINH VIJAYSINH
MOHITE-PATIL: W ill the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the total amount sanctioned for
Urban Infrastructure and Governance
(UIG) under Jawaharlal Nehru National
Urban Renewal Mission (JNNURM) for
various projects in Maharashtra;
(b) whether any additional grant has
also been sanctioned by the Planning
Commission for completion of the project;
and
(c) if so, the additional amount
sanctioned so far?
Parking arrangements during
CWG
*55. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of parking arrangements,
temporary and permanent, made by DDA
during CWG-2010;
(b) the details of the fund spent for
parking arrangements by DDA during
CWG;
(c) whether tender was awarded to
private players for arrangements of
temporary parking at Siri Fort Stadium
during the games;
(d) if so, the details thereof along with
the name of companies; and
(e) the details of amount allocated and
spent for parking arrangements at Siri Fort?

17
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Houses for urban poor
†*56. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of
HOUSING AND URBAN POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of population whose
housing needs have been met and to what
extent;
(b) whether majority of population has
no houses;
(c) whether Government proposes to
formulate a new housing scheme to ensure
housing within the stipulated period,
especially for the urban poor in the country;
and
(d) if so, by when it will be implemented?
Development schemes for naxal
affected districts
†*57. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of naxal affected districts
in the country;
(b) whether Government is considering
to speed up the development work in naxal
affected districts in order to reduce the
influence of naxalism;
(c) whether it is a fact that Government
is preparing integrated development
schemes for 65 districts, including 35 naxal
affected districts, out of 250 backward
districts of the country;
(d) if so, by when these integrated
development schemes would be
implemented; and
(e) by when the integrated development
schemes for rest of the naxal affected
districts would be prepared?
Ground water levels
*58. SHRI ANIL MADHA V DA VE:
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the expenditure on water
conservation programme during the last ten
years, State/Union Territory-wise; and
(b) the increase/decrease in ground water
levels in all these States/Union Territories
during the same time?
Assistance to increase irrigation
capacity of Jharkhand
*59. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has any plan
to assist the State Government of
Jharkhand to increase its irrigation capacity
since the State has hardly 6 per cent
irrigation capacity;
(b) whether the Ministry would declare
some of the half completed dams of
Jharkhand as national projects such as
Swarnrekha Dam; and
(c) the specific assistance that the
Ministry can offer to Jharkhand to increase
its irrigation potential specially in Left Wing
Extremism districts of Jharkhand?
CBI investigation on IFFI
*60. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the investigation
commenced by the Central Bureau of
Investigation with respect to International
Film Festival of India (IFFI), held in the
year 2004, has been completed;

18
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 4th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Kartika 13, 1932 (Saka)
(b) whether the CBI has collected all
the information in connection with the FIR
being investigated by them;
(c) the number of persons interrogated
and arrested, if any, in the matter;
(d) whether the CBI officials visited the
sites connected with the case and whether
they have inspected the infrastructure
created for IFFI 2004;
(e) whether all documents have been
obtained from the State Government; and
(f) by what date the charge-sheet is
expected to be filed considering the time
taken so far?
